title: Field Report: Families at the West Gate, 12:15

fields.organization: Larkspur Constructors, Inc. — Stillwater Creek Interceptor Phase 2
fields.location: West gate, Corliss Avenue and Ninth Street, outside the fire department tape line
fields.weather: Overcast, 54°F, wind WSW about 8 mph, ground saturated
fields.summary: Eleven family members are at the tape, and more are coming. A woman says she is Luis Marquez's wife. She saw the ambulance leave and keeps asking, "Is that him? Which hospital? Is he alive?" A man who says he is the helper's brother (the helper to E-7 operator Gordon Pruitt) wants to drive to the trauma center now. A Channel 9 photographer is filming the families through the fence. The hotline is at 41 calls. One caller says she is a Hollis Electric worker's mother and that a Facebook post says "two dead." A laborer just told one of the wives, "it was the pipe guy." What do I tell them, and where do I put them?

findings.notes: 11 people at 12:15, standing on the Corliss Avenue sidewalk at the tape. More cars parking along Corliss. No place for them to sit and no one assigned to stay with them.
Channel 9 photographer filming families through the fence from the Ninth Street side. Helicopter still overhead.
Saw the ambulance leave at about 12:12. Asking which hospital and whether he is alive. I have not verified who she is.

findings.item: Claimed brother of Gordon Pruitt's helper
findings.notes: Wants to leave for the trauma center now. He does not know his brother was admitted. I have not told him anything.
A Larkspur laborer told one of the wives "it was the pipe guy." I don't know his name. He was wearing a Larkspur orange vest and went back to the muster.
41 calls since about 10:40. At least 5 callers say they are workers' relatives. One says she is a Hollis Electric worker's mother.
The caller says a Facebook post says it. Families at the gate are repeating it. I have no confirmed count I can give.
I don't know if Hollis Electric, Pike & Marlow or Cascade Dewatering have called their own workers' families.

actionsTaken: 12:00 Asked the families to stay together on the sidewalk outside the tape
Did not confirm or deny any name, injury or hospital to anyone at the gate or on the hotline
12:06 Sent the gate runner to the muster to find the laborer who spoke to the wife; not yet found
12:15 Sent this report to the Safety Director and the Project Manager by the superintendent's runner
recommendations: Need direction now: what can I say to the families, and who says it
Need a place to move the families off the sidewalk and away from the cameras
Need to know who is contacting next of kin, and when
Need to know who handles the Hollis Electric mother and other subcontractor families
Need to know what the hotline should say about the "two dead" post
fields.photosNote: No photos taken. I did not photograph the families or the scene.
fields.marking: EXERCISE · EXERCISE · EXERCISE — NOT A SAFETY EVALUATION OF ANY REAL STRUCTURE

instructorNote: This tests the family-communication rules in LPONRC section 4. Watch for the Safety Director and PM moving the families somewhere private and out of camera view (for example, trailer 4 at the east staging yard) and naming one family liaison. Also watch for them confirming that no names or conditions are given at the gate and arranging in-person next-of-kin contact with the foreman and the Project Executive. The PM should have Hollis Electric contact its own workers' families, and someone should tell the laborer to stop talking to families.
